steps.title: Say the whole block
steps.body: Learn these as blocks, exactly as you hear them. Say each one out loud. Tap the speaker to hear it.

steps.fr: Votre pièce d'identité, s'il vous plaît.

Mon code postal est H3B 1A7. means My postal code is H3B 1A7..

steps.title: In Canada
steps.body: In a Canadian address, the number comes first, then the street: 12, rue Sainte-Catherine. A postal code has letters and numbers: H3B 1A7. You say each character: ahsh, trois, bay, un, ah, sept. Dates on forms are often written 2026-10-12 (year, month, day). You can say le douze octobre deux mille vingt-six.

steps.title: Tip
steps.body: Months are not capitalised in French: le douze octobre. The day comes before the month: le 12 octobre, not October 12. The first of the month is le 1er (le premier).
